blocks.text: Former “Pinoy Big Brother (PBB) Collab 2.0” housemate Rave Victoria and rising actor Lance Jeremy are teaming up as rivals-turned-lovers in “Coach Me Maybe,” iWant’s first-ever boys’ love (BL) vertical series. All episodes of the upcoming digital project will drop on Friday, Nov. 20, exclusively on the streaming platform. “Coach Me Maybe” explores queer romance through the dynamic between a cocky judo champion named Alpha (Jeremy) and a nerdy academic achiever named Romeo (Victoria).
